content: Ba nam ni bfel’ ni ngan tafnay

“Urngin fapi motochiyel ni kug pi’ ngomed e daba’ e ngu’um folgad riy u fithik’ e yul’yul’, nge yag ni mfosgad mu’um yo’orgad mi gimed tafnay e re nam nem ni SOMOL e micheg ngak pi chitamangimed ni kakrom nra pi’ ngomed.

Mu tafnay niged rogon ni i pow’iymed SOMOL ni Got romed u daken e ted i yan ni aningeg i ragag e duw ni ba milekag nib n’uw wo’en, ma be pi’ bogi n’en nib mo’maw’ be yib ngomed ni be sikeng nagmed, ya nge guy e n’en ni gimed ra rin’ ko gimed ra fol ko tin keyog ni ngu’um rin’ed fa dangay.

Me pagmed ngam pired ndariy ban’en ni gimed ra kay, me pi’ e manna ngomed ni ngam ked, nib ggan ni dawor mu ked bi’id ma ku arogon e pi chitamangimed ni kakrom. I rin’ e ren’ey ngomed ni fan e nge fil ngomed ni gathi go’ flowa e ma tay e girdi’ nib fos, machane gubin bug e thin ni yib u langan SOMOL e ra tay e girdi’ nib fos.
Mad romed e de kaday ma rifrif u aymed e de thow u lan e re aningeg i ragag i duw nem.
Thingar mu nanged u lanin’med ni SOMOL ni Got romed e ma yal’uweg mma gechignag pifak nri bod e pi matam nge matin ni yad ma gechignag pifakrad.
Ere ngu’um folgad ko tin keyog SOMOL ngomed ni ngu’um rin’ed, um folgad ko pi motochiyel rok mu um pired ni bay madgun u wun’med;

ya SOMOL ni Got romed e be fekmed i yan nga ba nam nib yong’ol e but’ riy, ni ba nam ni bay e lul’ riy, nge alublub, ma bay e ran u tan e but’ riy ni be yib e ran riy ngalang u lan e yu pa’ i loway nge pi burey,
ni ba nam ni be tugul e woldug ni wheat riy nge barley, nge grape, nge fig, nge pomegranate, nge olive, ma ku bay e honey riy.
Gimed ra par u rom ma dab m’ad ko bilig fa mu yoyowolgad u ban’en. Ma malang riy e bay e wasey u fithik’, ma burey riy e rayag ni ngam kered e wasey ni copper u fithik’.
Bay um pired u rom nib yu’ ngomed urngin e tin ngam ked, ma bay um pininged e magaer ngak SOMOL ni Got romed ni bochan e re nam nem nike pi’ ngomed nib yong’ol e but’ riy.
Ngan kol ayuw ni dab ni pag Talin SOMOL
“Ngu’um guyed rogon ndab mpaged talin SOMOL ni Got romed; thingar um folgad u urngin e pi motochiyel rok ni kug pi’ ngomed e daba’.
Ngiyal’ nra yu’ ngomed urngin e tin ngam ked ma kam toyed e naun ni bfel’ gimed be par riy,
ma ke yo’or e garbaw nge saf romed, nge silber, nge gol, ma ke yo’or ban’en romed,
ma ngar mu guyed rogon ya richey nge tolangan’med ngam paged talin SOMOL ni Got romed, ni ir e chuwegmed u Egypt, ni um pired riy ni gimed e sib.

I pow’iymed i yan u lan e ted ni desert ma ba kan dugwen ya bay e porchoyog riy ni bay e yub u l’ugun, ma ku bay e scorpion riy. U rom u daken e ted nib mlik’ e but’ riy ma dariy e ran riy e gagiyegnag SOMOL e ran nge yib i po’ nga but’ u fithik’ ba war nib el ni fan ngomed;

u rom u daken e ted e pi’ e manna ngu’um ked, ni ba ggan ndawori kay e chitamangimed ni kakrom bi’id. I pi’ bogi n’en nib mo’maw’ nge yib ngomed ni nge sikeng nagmed, ya nge yan i tomur me yu’nag e tin bfel’ ngomed.
Ere dabi ga’ar bigimed u wan’, ‘Gelngig nge fanag madangdang e ke yagnag ngog e re fel’ rogon ney ni kug tay.’

Dab mu paged talin ni SOMOL ni Got romed e ir e be pi’ gelngimed be yo’or ban’en romed. Be rin’ ni ara’ rogon, ni bochan e ka daba’ ma ku be par nib yul’yul’ ko fare m’ag ni ngongliy u thilrad e chitamangimed ni kakrom.

Ri dab mpaged talin SOMOL ni Got romed fa mu pi’ed keru’med ngak ngu’um ted fan yugu boch e got ma gimed be pigpig ngorad. Fa’an gimed ra rin’ ma gu be micheg ngomed e daba’ nrib muduwgil ni yira thirifmed u but’.
Fa’anra dab um folgad rok SOMOL mra thirifmed u but’, ni bod rogon fapi nam ni thirifrad u but’ ko ngiyal’ ni gimed be yan i yan nga m’on.
